home.description: Hand a long task to your models. The Workshop plans it, writes it part by part, checks every part and delivers the files in a folder. Time doesn't count: quality does.
home.empty: No projects yet. Describe what you need and the Workshop does the rest.

settings.title: Workshop settings
settings.noFolder: No Documents folder was found: choose a folder for your projects.
settings.webHint: Projects may search the web when their task needs it.

autonomy.label: Autonomy

help.plan: The Workshop frames the task and drafts a plan, then waits: you read it, change it and start the work.
help.ask: It asks you to approve the plan, and before every action with an effect (a web search, reading a page).
help.acceptActions: It asks you to approve the plan only; then it works on its own, web included.
help.autonomous: It asks nothing: its questions become written assumptions, and it approves its own plan.

autonomy.shortcut: <kbd>Shift+Tab</kbd> in the task changes it; <kbd>Esc</kbd> then <kbd>Shift+Tab</kbd> leaves the task.

new.title: New project
new.taskPlaceholder: Describe the task: what you want, for whom, how long. For example: a 3,000-word guide to urban permaculture for beginners.
new.drop: Drop your documents to attach them
new.modelAutoChosen: The Workshop will use {model}, chosen automatically.

modelErrors.noModel: No model is installed. Download one in the ModelHub first.
modelErrors.modelNotFound: This model is no longer installed.
modelErrors.remoteOff: This is a cloud model, and cloud models are turned off in the settings.
modelErrors.contextTooSmall: This model can't hold enough context for a project (at least 16,384 tokens).
modelErrors.unknown: This model can't be used for a project.

view.stopMessage: What's already written stays in its folder, but the project can't be resumed.
view.deleteMessage: Its folder is {folder}. Keep the files, or delete them with the project?

plan.title: Plan
plan.directHint: The Workshop first writes everything in one go, then checks it. It splits the work into parts only if that version fails.

part.label: Selected part
part.noOwnCheck: No separate check for this part.

activity.label: What the Workshop is doing
activity.queued: Waiting for its turn: position {position} in the queue.
activity.waiting: I need you: answer below so I can go on.
activity.yielding: You're using the app: the project waits until you're done.
activity.paused: Paused. Nothing is lost: resume it whenever you like.
activity.done: Done! Everything is in the project folder.
activity.gpuLent: The text model lends the graphics card to {engine}…
activity.choosingStrategy: Choosing the best way to do it (vote {draw} of 3)…
activity.summarizingBrick: Summing up “{part}” for the next parts…
activity.fixingSentences: Correcting the sentences judged wrong in “{part}”…
activity.delivering: Writing the files to the project folder…

log.title: Activity log
log.gpuBack: Graphics card back to the text model.
log.yielding: On hold while you use the app.

strategy.title: Which way should I take?
strategy.hint: My votes disagreed. Choose how to lead this project.

framing.title: A few questions before I start
framing.hint: Answer what you can. A blank answer becomes a written assumption.

plan.title: Here's the plan
plan.hint: Change the titles, goals, lengths or order if you like, then approve it. Or ask for another plan and say why.
plan.missingDocumentTitle: Give the document a title to approve the plan.
plan.missingPartTitle: Give part {number} a title to approve the plan.
plan.missingPartWords: Give part {number} (“{title}”) a number of words to approve the plan.
plan.notePlaceholder: For example: fewer parts, one part per season, no part about tools.
plan.noteIgnored: Approving doesn't send your note: it's only used when you ask for another plan.

report.title: Verification report

route.direct: Written in one go, then checked.
route.parts: Written part by part, then assembled and checked.

report.outline: The criteria were judged on the outline only: the document was too long to be judged in one go.

notCheckedCodes.factJudge: The accuracy of the facts: the judge couldn't answer.
notCheckedCodes.formJudge: The form: the judge couldn't answer.
notCheckedCodes.documents: Part of the attached documents: they were too long and were cut.

report.proofread: Language proofreading: {blocks} passages read, {changed} corrected, {rejected} corrections set aside.

codes.internalWord: No Workshop wording left in the text
codes.registryConflict: Decision contrary to the shared list
codes.copiedRemark: Judge's remark copied into the text

modelWarnings.tooSmall: This model is very small: the result will likely be poor.
modelWarnings.small: This model is small: expect a modest result.
modelWarnings.smallContext: This model holds little context: long tasks will suffer.
modelWarnings.noThinking: This model can't think before answering: plans and checks will be weaker.
modelWarnings.unknownSize: The size of this model is unknown: the Workshop can't tell whether it's big enough.

warnings.strategyNotYet: That strategy isn't available yet: the general one was used.
warnings.planBestOfThree: No plan was flawless: the best of three was kept.
warnings.planDefect: The plan kept has a flaw.
warnings.specBestOfThree: No specification was flawless: the best of three was kept.
warnings.specDefect: The specification kept has a flaw.
warnings.registryCondensed: The list of shared decisions was condensed to fit.
warnings.registryConflict: Two decisions disagreed: one was set aside.
warnings.judgeUnavailable: A judge couldn't answer: one point wasn't checked.
warnings.attachmentsCut: The attached documents were too long and were cut.
warnings.lengthCapped: The length asked for was too much for this model and was reduced.
warnings.modelRetry: The model's answer was unreadable: asked again.
warnings.directFailed: The one-go version didn't pass the checks: switching to a plan.
warnings.documentCriteriaRemoved: Criteria about the whole document were taken out of the parts.
warnings.looping: The model was repeating itself: stopped and retried.
warnings.briefTooLong: The instructions for a part were too long and were shortened.
warnings.proofreadRejected: A language correction was set aside: it changed too much.
warnings.surgeryNotFound: A sentence to correct wasn't found in the text.
warnings.surgeryRejected: A sentence correction went too far: the text was kept.
warnings.generic: Something unexpected happened; the project went on.

errors.strategyNotYet: This kind of project isn't available yet.
errors.specUndecided: The specification stayed undecided: the task needs to be clearer.
errors.planUnusable: No usable plan could be drafted.
errors.deliverWriteFailed: The files couldn't be written to the project folder.
errors.modelNotFound: The project's model is no longer installed.
errors.remoteOff: The project's model is a cloud model, and cloud models are turned off.
errors.contextTooSmall: The model can't hold enough context for a project.
errors.contextExceeded: The model ran out of context.
errors.incomplete: The model's answers stayed cut off.
errors.connection: The connection to the model was lost.
errors.account: The cloud account refused the request.
